name: Information Exposure via HTTP Header
description: Endpoint /healthcheck returns sensitive server and library versions in X-Powered-By response header.

name: Missing Function Level Access Control (BOLA/BFLA)
description: Endpoint DELETE /menu/{item_id} lacks role-based authorization check, allowing any authenticated user to delete menu items.

name: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR / BOLA)
description: Endpoint PUT /profile updates the profile of user specified in request body rather than binding updates strictly to current_user.

name: Broken Function Level Authorization (Privilege Escalation)
description: Endpoint PUT /users/update_role allows regular customers to promote themselves to Employee role due to missing caller privilege check.

name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
description: Function _image_url_to_base64 downloads arbitrary URLs using requests.get without validating host, protocol, or IP address.

name: OS Command Injection (RCE)
description: Function get_disk_usage concatenates user-supplied parameters into shell string executed via subprocess.run(..., shell=True).
